title: Every Cech cochain lifts to one Koszul exponent
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, f : Fin r → A, and F an integer-indexed complex of sheaves of modules on Spec(A), with every F.X q quasi-coherent. For the specified diagram and cocone [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction], every element y of degree n of the principal alternating Cech total [def-sc-principal-open-alternating-total] is the image of a degree-n element z at a single stage e : ℕ under the cocone leg, transported to the specified target by its point equality. No cycle condition is assumed.

source.place: Tags 08D0 and 08D1, localization fraction map and finite total-degree diagonals; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08D0 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08D1.

proof.text:
Transport the target through principalCechObjIso. For each nonempty subset J,
put p = card(J)-1 and q = n-p. Quasi-coherence on Spec(A) identifies its section on
D(g_J), where g_J is the product of the f_j, with the localization of global
sections of F.X q. Write that section, after multiplication by the inverse of
Int.negOnePow(p*q+p*(p-1)/2), as m_J/g_J^d_J. There are finitely many J, so choose
E >= 1 and E >= d_J for all J. Replace m_J by g_J^(E-d_J) m_J. At stage e = E-1,
define each linear map on the ordered exterior basis by these numerators. Terms
outside the tail's finite support are zero. The free exterior bases therefore give
a homogeneous module Hom cochain, and koszulCechHomObjIso transports it to the
specified diagram. The cocone formula gives exactly the chosen sections: g_J is
invertible on D(g_J), so the formula can be divided by g_J^E. Transport back through
principalCechObjIso. For r=0 the target has no coordinates, and the zero cochain at
stage 0 suffices; for zero or nilpotent g_J its localized section module is zero.
This argument uses cochains, with no cycle or boundedness condition on F. Mathlib tools: Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent and isIso_fromTildeΓ_iff_isLocalizing identify restriction with localization; Module.Basis.exteriorPower on the standard Finsupp basis gives the ordered exterior coordinates. The formula and object transports are provided by the comparison construction; the specified exterior diagonal transition is supplied by the Koszul open system.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulCechCocone_stage_lifting
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (F : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, (F.X n).IsQuasicoherent) (n : ℤ)
    (y : ((principalCechFunctor r f).obj F).X n) :
    ∃ (e : ℕ) (z : ((koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
      (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj F)).obj
        e).X n),
      (((koszulCechCocone A r f F).ι.app e ≫
        eqToHom (koszulCechCocone_exists A r f F).choose_spec.1).f n) z = y
